# RuleBlast — Git diff for AI agent repository instructions

> Git diff for AI agent repository instructions. Shows the blast radius of AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md changes across Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and Copilot CLI.

RuleBlast answers the problem query: which files inherit a changed AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md? Git shows the first diff. RuleBlast shows the second.

- Repository: https://github.com/Kpoiut/ruleblast
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/ruleblast
- Landing: https://kpoiut.github.io/ruleblast/
- Problem page: https://github.com/Kpoiut/ruleblast/blob/main/which-files-inherit-agents-md.md
- Sealed case: 2 instruction-line edits → 206 Codex stacks — https://github.com/Kpoiut/ruleblast/blob/main/PROOF.md
- CLI: npx --yes ruleblast@2.5.7 .
- This tree is 2.5.9. Published CLI is ruleblast@2.5.7. Human diff adds OTHER TRACKED CHANGES, CHANGE ALIGNMENT, INTENT, and a WORK MAP. Default text is the summary; --detail prints the same result in full, including EVIDENCE and the Candidate Reality Conformance Lab. The same result can print --paths-only, --index, explain --compare, and a PROOF line. `--index` is the compact PAIR/NEWPAIR/CONVPAIR/INDPAIR map whose counts fold from PAIRPATH/NEWPAIRPATH/CONVPAIRPATH/INDPAIRPATH rows for agents on large repositories. It does not write a file. The lab is not a model-quality score. ORACLE is a sealed interpreter digest match. ADAPTER is a sealed fingerprint-adapter digest match. RECORDED is not a passing oracle. LOADED is a candidate snapshot that constructed, not a passing projection. Which files now inherit different AI instructions?

Local. Read-only. Deterministic. Not a claim about model compliance.
